containers.name: prod
containers.description: Root of the prod HDFS environment.

containers.name: raw
containers.description: Raw zone: straight from FTP, no transform.

containers.name: datalake_raw
containers.description: Datalake job outputs, grouped by job name.

containers.name: mymo_daily_limit_data_collection_raw
containers.description: Unzipped, validated files straight from FTP, before any processing. Each file has its own subfolder (mymo_transaction_limit/, mymo_set_limit/), split into a CKSUM/ subfolder for the checksum file and a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder for the CSV.

containers.name: mymo_transaction_limit_raw
containers.description: Raw CSV data file mymo_transaction_limit_<yyyymmdd>.csv, landing under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder. A companion .cksum file lands in a sibling CKSUM/ subfolder for checksum validation, not modeled as a separate catalog entity.

columns.name: limit
columns.description: Initial limit set by the system before the customer adjusts it (Limit)

columns.name: spentroom
columns.description: Remaining daily limit available for use (SpentRoom)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount of the transaction made that day (Amount)

columns.name: app_mode
columns.description: Customer's application mode: L = MyMo Secure plus, N = MyMo normal mode (AppMode)

columns.name: limit_mode
columns.description: Customer's limit mode, derived from AppMode + Tier: SECURE_PLUS, NORMAL, SMALL (LimitMode)

containers.name: mymo_set_limit_raw
containers.description: Raw CSV data file mymo_set_limit_<yyyymmdd>.csv, landing under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder. A companion .cksum file lands in a sibling CKSUM/ subfolder for checksum validation, not modeled as a separate catalog entity.

columns.name: pre_limit
columns.description: Initial limit set by the system before the customer adjusts it (PreLimit)

columns.name: changing_limit
columns.description: Daily limit amount after adjustment / post limit (ChangingLimit)

columns.name: limit_mode
columns.description: Customer's limit mode, derived from AppMode + Tier: SECURE_PLUS, NORMAL, SMALL (LimitMode)

containers.name: gold_safe
containers.description: Staging copy of raw output, immediately before Hive load.

containers.name: datalake_gold_safe
containers.description: Datalake job outputs, grouped by job name.

containers.name: mymo_daily_limit_data_collection_gold_safe
containers.description: Copy of the raw-zone output for mymo_daily_limit_data_collection, staged here before loading into Hive. This pipeline has no separate cleansed zone -- gold_safe is staged directly from raw.
